messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — vendor HyperFreight updated replacement ETA for 12x H100s to Fri 03:00 UTC. Need to lock depot acceptance window and RMA AWB consolidation. Possible customs hold in FRA. Anyone on this?
maria: thanks. can you drop vendor contact + AWB? staging window we have is Fri 08:00-12:00 CET at FRA depot.
alex: @hyperfreight_ops can you confirm pickup ETA and if you can consolidate to a single AWB? Also HS code we use is `8542.31.00` right?
hyperfreight_ops: Confirmed pickup ETA 02:30 UTC. We can consolidate, but carrier requests extra brokerage for consolidated AWB (~€420). Also flag: two units show "DOA?" in manifest — need serials before consolidation.
jordan: does consolidation reduce customs risk? consolidation sometimes triggers deeper inspection at FRA.
sanjay: If we split AWBs, we avoid single customs spike, but increases courier cost + extra dock fees. tradeoff: cost vs inspection risk. numbers?
maria: cost calc: single AWB courier €1,100 + brokerage €420 = €1,520. Split into 2 AWBs courier €1,600 total, no brokerage. delta €80 more to split. but inspection risk lower with split? uncertain.
alex: ops-bot: routing-sim run for consolidated AWB vs split (simulate customs hold probability).
ops-bot: routing-sim result: consolidated AWB => 18% higher inspection probability for FRA vs split. Expected delay consolidated = +14 hrs; split = +4 hrs.
maria: ok so consolidated saves €80 but adds expected 10 hrs delay. Customer SLA needs <12 hr ramp to capacity for this region — that's tight.
hyperfreight_ops: Also RMA note: for the two DOA candidates we need RMA labels returned to our depot before dispatch; if we consolidate, please ensure returns box included. We can pre-create return labels: `AWB-RMA-1761-RF`.
jordan: action: can we get depot acceptance window extended to 20:00 CET as contingency? @fra-depot-ops
maria: fra-depot-ops: we can extend to 18:00 CET on Friday only. night pick requires extra staffing + €300 overtime.
alex: decision proposal: split AWBs to minimize customs risk and avoid potential >12 hr delay. Accept extra €80 + potential extra dock ops. Also vendor to pre-create RMA labels and upload serials.
sanjay: +1. Also request vendor to upload S/N CSV to shared drive by EOD so we can validate before consolidation: format `serial,model,status`.
hyperfreight_ops: I'll upload S/N CSV by 16:00 UTC. For DOA candidates: can we do "partial replace" flow — ship 10 live + 2 loaners until DOA confirmed? paperwork wise ok.
maria: paperwork note: For partial replace, customs doc must list `temporary import` value flag. Use incoterm DAP to reduce import liability.
alex: Can someone make a quick cost vs SLA note for execs? bullet: split AWBs + overtime = +€380, expected on-time ramp ~98%. consolidated = -€80, expected on-time ramp ~85% (risk).
jordan: I'll paste numbers in #finance later.
shipping-bot: shipping-bot created AWB placeholder `HF-1761234999-PL` awaiting final manifest.
alex: ok let's lock: split AWBs, vendor to upload CSV, RMA labels pre-created, extend depot acceptance to 18:00 CET (maria to confirm overtime charge). I'll follow up EOD. :thumbsup:
maria: confirmed 18:00 CET extension + €300 OT. agree to split. I'll send PO amendment to vendor.
hyperfreight_ops: Received. Uploading CSV now. Will mark DOA units and create RMA labels. ETA update if anything changes.
alex: thanks all. Closing loop: @oncall-sre — FYI we'll have staggered capacity coming online Fri afternoon; might need to backfill some low-priority queues.
oncall-sre: noted. will adjust scheduler priorities to route critical tests to eu-dedicated pool.
End of thread.
